messages:
sara: Hey team — quick sync: we're proposing schema changes so customer-facing audit events can be validated end-to-end and also support WORM + per-tenant KMS archival. Need input on coverage and retention. Key Qs: scope of events, immutable marker, and where to stash archive KMS ARN.

mike: For coverage — include authz changes, API key rotations, model-rollouts, and Dedicated deployment config changes. All admin-level actions + data-export / download events.

priyanka: Compliance asks that retention and immutability are explicit in event metadata. We need an `event_retention_policy` tag (e.g., `cust:7y`,`sys:2y`) and `immutable_until` timestamp.

alex: Suggest adding `immutable: true|false` and `imm_until: ISO8601` fields, and an `archive_destination` object with `type: s3|gcs` and `kms_key_id`.

sara: Draft schema snippet:
```json
{
  "event_type": "string",
  "actor": {"id":"string","role":"string"},
  "resource": {"id":"string","type":"string"},
  "action": "string",
  "timestamp": "ISO8601",
  "immutable": true,
  "imm_until": "ISO8601",
  "retention_policy": "cust:7y",
  "archive_destination": {"bucket":"string","region":"string","kms_key_id":"arn:aws:kms:..."}
}
```

mike: +1 on schema. Operational note: immutable flag must be enforced at storage layer (WORM object store or special S3 Object Lock). We can't rely on app-layer flag alone.

auditsvc-bot: FYI — current archive flow supports S3 Object Lock + KMS CMK outlines. See `/infra/archive/README` for policy. :information_source:

priyanka: Can we make `archive_kms_key` per-tenant? Legal requires tenant-segregated keys for some contracts.

alex: Yes, Dedicated/Private will have per-tenant KMS. Hosted customers default to shared CMKs unless they bring-your-own (BYOK). We need metadata to store `kms_wrapped_keys` or `envelope_kek_id`.

sara: How do we validate customer-facing audit events? Need deterministic schema validation and signed attestations where customers can verify event integrity.

mike: Option A: sign event payloads with a service signing key and expose attestation endpoint. Option B: include SHA256 + salt recorded in WORM store and provide proof API. Both require key lifecycle management.

jen: Legal: exportability is important. Customers must be able to request export of their immutable audit records. Include export SLA and how KMS rotation affects exports.

priyanka: Retention enforcement: we must ensure `immutable_until` > now + retention_window. Also have a late-append model: events may be corrected, so allow append-only corrections with cross-reference to original event id.

alex: Implementation plan:
- Schema PR in `audits/schema` repo -> validation library deploy
- Storage: S3 with Object Lock enabled + bucket per-tenant for enterprise -> lifecycle rules
- Archive pipeline signs + writes event and pushes digest to ledger service
- KMS: per-tenant CMKs where contract requires BYOK

sara: Blockers: audit-eval harness to exercise schema + customer validation. @auditsvc-bot can you run a small test set with tenant BYOK and shared CMK?

auditsvc-bot: Running test job 4521. Will post results in thread when complete. :gear:

mike: One more ops note — avoid storing plaintext PII in audit event; instead store redaction pointers. If need full payload for forensics, store encrypted blobs with customer CMK.

sara: Thanks all. I'll open a tracking RFC and link this thread. Follow-ups: RFC + schema PR + infra test job. :thumbsup:
